form.official-title: To direct the Secretary of Agriculture to convey to Brian Head Town, Utah, certain National Forest System land.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Brian Head Town Land Conveyance Act.

section.header: Conveyance of Federal land to Brian Head Town, Utah

subparagraph.text: the parcel of approximately 24 acres of National Forest System land within the boundary of the Dixie National Forest, as generally depicted as NFS Lands Selected for Transfer on the map entitled Forest Service to Brian Head Land Transfer and dated April 28, 2025; and
any improvements to the National Forest System land described in subparagraph (A).

paragraph.text: The term Secretary means the Secretary of Agriculture, acting through the Chief of the Forest Service.
The term Town means Brian Head Town, Utah.

subsection.text: As soon as practicable after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary shall convey to the Town, without consideration and subject to any terms and conditions that the Secretary determines to be appropriate, all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to the Federal land, to be used by the Town for a public works facility or any other uses determined to be necessary by the Town.
On the conveyance of the Federal land to the Town under subsection (b), the Secretary shall modify the boundary of the Dixie National Forest to reflect the conveyance of the Federal land.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Brian Head Town Land Conveyance Act.

section.header: Conveyance of Federal land to Brian Head Town, Utah

subparagraph.text: the parcel of approximately 24 acres of National Forest System land within the boundary of the Dixie National Forest, as generally depicted as NFS Lands Selected for Transfer on the map entitled Forest Service to Brian Head Land Transfer and dated April 28, 2025; and
any improvements to the National Forest System land described in subparagraph (A).

paragraph.text: The term Secretary means the Secretary of Agriculture, acting through the Chief of the Forest Service.
The term Town means Brian Head Town, Utah.

subsection.text: As soon as practicable after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary shall convey to the Town, without consideration and subject to any terms and conditions that the Secretary determines to be appropriate, all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to the Federal land, to be used by the Town—

paragraph.text: to develop and expand public safety infrastructure and a public works facility; and
to expand public recreational access and opportunities within the Town.

subsection.text: On the conveyance of the Federal land to the Town under subsection (b), the Secretary shall modify the boundary of the Dixie National Forest to reflect the conveyance of the Federal land.

paragraph.text: If the Secretary, after consultation with the State of Utah, determines that the Federal land conveyed under subsection (b) was used by the Town for a use not authorized under that subsection, all right, title, and interest in and to the Federal land shall revert to the United States, at the discretion of the Secretary.
Prior to a determination under paragraph (1), the Secretary shall—

subparagraph.text: notify the Town of the nonconforming use;
provide an opportunity for a hearing, at the request of the Town;
provide public notice and an opportunity for public comment; and
provide the Town a reasonable opportunity to correct any identified uses that could result in reversion of the title to the United States.
